news.title: Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin helped off ice after fall
news.ruTitle: Вратарь «Рейнджерс» Игорь Шестеркин помог оторваться от льда после падения
news.description: New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin, the 30-year-old Russian who won the 2022 Vezina Trophy, had to be helped off the ice after an awkward fall into his own net against the Washington Capitals on Friday night at Capital One Arena.

news.title: Predators acquire Jayden Struble, 25, from Canadiens
news.description: The Nashville Predators bolstered their blue line on Friday night, adding defenseman Jayden Struble, 25, in a trade with the Montreal Canadiens, in exchange for a second-round draft pick in 2027.

news.title: Senators' Eklund out for 'extended' period with ankle injury
news.ruTitle: Эклунд из сенаторов выбыл на «длительный» период из-за травмы лодыжки
news.description: Senators forward William Eklund, who left Thursday's win over the Flyers after taking a hit, will miss an "extended" period of time with an ankle injury.

news.title: Defenseman Matt Dumba, 32, retires after 13 NHL seasons
news.ruTitle: Защитник Мэтт Дамба, 32 года, уходит в отставку после 13 сезонов в НХЛ
news.description: Matt Dumba, the 32-year-old defenseman who won the 2020 King Clancy Memorial Trophy, given to the player who best exemplified leadership qualities on and off the ice, is retiring after 13 NHL seasons with five different teams.

news.title: Panthers eyeing six-week timeline for Brad Marchand's return
news.ruTitle: «Пантеры» рассматривают шестинедельный график возвращения Брэда Маршана
news.description: The Panthers are expecting forward Brad Marchand to miss about six weeks with his left leg injury, a timeline that coincides with Aleksander Barkov being out six to eight weeks.
